$comment: Device configuration. Anything here overrides the mosque preset in mosques/<mosque>.json. Edit and commit; devices pick it up on their next refresh. A device can also keep a local-only override at /etc/prayer-sync/config.local.json which wins over everything.

stream.$comment: provider: mixlr | static | icecast. Resolved fresh at play time, never trusted from cache alone.

audio.$comment: output: auto | bluetooth | aux | hdmi | usb | <exact sink/device name>. 'auto' walks 'priority' and uses the first one that really plays.

schedule.$comment: Which prayers to broadcast, and which timetable fields bracket the window.

offsets.$comment: pre = minutes BEFORE start_anchor to open the stream. post = minutes AFTER stop_anchor to close it. 'default' applies to anything not listed.

offline.$comment: When no fresh timetable can be fetched, times are computed locally from lat/long. assumed_iqamah_gap replaces the unknowable iqamah time.

quiet_hours.$comment: Optional hard mute window (local time). Set enabled=true to suppress playback overnight regardless of schedule.
